nearby_infrastructure.name: An Phu Interchange
nearby_infrastructure.description: A key grade-separated road interchange in eastern Ho Chi Minh City, improving connectivity between Mai Chi Tho Boulevard, the Ho Chi Minh City – Long Thanh – Dau Giay Expressway, Luong Dinh Cua Street, and surrounding roads.

progress.completion_rate: Approximately 75%, according to information published in September 2026
progress.expected_completion: Q3 2027, according to the revised project schedule

under_construction.name: N2 Bridge and Approach Roads
under_construction.status: The main bridge structure has been connected, and concrete works for the bridge deck have been completed according to September 2026 reports. Approach roads and finishing works were still underway at the time of reporting.

under_construction.name: N1.1 Ramp
under_construction.status: Construction is ongoing to connect Mai Chi Tho Boulevard with the Ho Chi Minh City – Long Thanh – Dau Giay Expressway. The actual opening date has not been independently confirmed in the sources reviewed.

under_construction.name: N1.2 Ramp and Luong Dinh Cua Street
under_construction.status: Progress has been affected by land clearance, including the handover of approximately 22,012 square meters along Luong Dinh Cua Street, as well as the construction of bridge approaches and related road infrastructure.

nearby_infrastructure.status: Construction is ongoing, with several components already open to traffic. Approximately 75% of the project had been completed according to information published in September 2026. Overall completion is scheduled for Q3 2027, subject to land clearance and construction progress on the remaining ramps.
nearby_infrastructure.relevance_to_project: The interchange is expected to improve road connectivity between The Privé, the Nam Rach Chiec area, Mai Chi Tho Boulevard, and the Ho Chi Minh City – Long Thanh – Dau Giay Expressway. It does not guarantee the complete elimination of traffic congestion.

source.name: Ho Chi Minh City Press Center; Construction Newspaper

nearby_infrastructure.name: Ho Chi Minh City – Long Thanh – Dau Giay Expressway
nearby_infrastructure.description: An existing expressway connecting Ho Chi Minh City with Dong Nai Province and eastern destinations. The Ho Chi Minh City – Long Thanh section is being expanded to increase traffic capacity and improve access to Long Thanh International Airport.
nearby_infrastructure.status: The existing expressway is operational, while the expansion project on the Ho Chi Minh City – Long Thanh section remains under construction. The operational status of the existing road should not be confused with the progress of the expansion project.

progress.completion_rate: Nearly 73% of the expansion project's contract value, according to a report dated October 7, 2026
progress.expected_completion: The road and viaduct sections are targeted for completion in November 2026, while the Long Thanh Bridge is expected to be completed in February 2027
under_construction: Expansion of the Ho Chi Minh City – Long Thanh expressway section
Completion of road sections and viaducts
Construction of the new Long Thanh Bridge
Implementation of remaining works in accordance with the project schedule

nearby_infrastructure.relevance_to_project: The expressway provides road connections from The Privé and the Nam Rach Chiec area to Dong Nai Province, eastern destinations, and Long Thanh International Airport. Actual travel times depend on traffic conditions, traffic management measures, and the progress of ongoing construction.

nearby_infrastructure.name: Long Thanh International Airport
nearby_infrastructure.description: A major international airport project in Dong Nai Province, envisioned as a key aviation hub for southern Vietnam and an important part of the region's transportation and logistics network.
nearby_infrastructure.status: The airport is undergoing final construction works, system checks, and operational testing. Information published in early October 2026 indicated a target date of December 24, 2026, for the initial phase of commercial operations. This remains a planned date and does not mean that the airport is already operational.

progress.expected_completion: The initial phase of commercial operations is targeted to begin on December 24, 2026, subject to operational testing, acceptance procedures, and aviation safety approvals
under_construction: Completion of the passenger terminal and facilities under Component Project 3
Completion of technical systems and aviation equipment
Operational testing and assessment of system and personnel readiness
Finalization of acceptance procedures and operating permits

nearby_infrastructure.relevance_to_project: The airport is expected to strengthen international air connectivity in southern Vietnam. Accessibility from The Privé will depend on the progress of connecting roads, actual traffic conditions, and the airport's operational schedule.

nearby_infrastructure.name: Rach Chiec National Sports Complex
nearby_infrastructure.description: A large-scale sports complex planned for eastern Ho Chi Minh City, featuring sports venues, training facilities, and supporting amenities for sporting events.
nearby_infrastructure.status: The project held its groundbreaking ceremony on January 15, 2026. Official information reviewed confirms the groundbreaking and investment direction, but does not establish the actual construction completion rate as of October 24, 2026.

progress.expected_completion: The initial plan indicated an implementation period of approximately eight years from the signing of the BT contract, with an ambition to shorten it to around five years. The latest completion schedule for individual components has not been confirmed.
under_construction: Implementation of the project in accordance with approved investment phases and procedures
Preparation of the site and construction conditions according to the project plan

nearby_infrastructure.relevance_to_project: The complex has the potential to support sports, services, and long-term urban development in eastern Ho Chi Minh City. No specific property price increase or completion date should be guaranteed without verified supporting information.

nearby_infrastructure.name: Thu Thiem – Long Thanh Metro Line
nearby_infrastructure.description: A proposed interregional urban railway intended to connect Thu Thiem Station in Ho Chi Minh City with the area around Long Thanh International Airport, supporting public transportation and regional connectivity.
nearby_infrastructure.status: The line remains in the investment preparation and project planning stage, including the completion of relevant procedures. The target groundbreaking date of September 2, 2026, was not met. As of late October 2026, the sources reviewed do not confirm that construction has started.

progress.expected_completion: A broader metro network development target for 2030 has been announced, but the line's specific approval status, groundbreaking date, and completion schedule should be verified before being presented to customers.
under_construction: Completion of investment procedures and implementation plans
Preparation of technical requirements and route alignment
Preparation for implementation in accordance with the approved project schedule

nearby_infrastructure.relevance_to_project: If implemented as planned, the metro line could improve public transportation links between Thu Thiem and Long Thanh International Airport. It should not be described as an operational metro line or as having an officially confirmed travel time.
